# Authentication form primitives

`components/ui/field.tsx` and `components/ui/label.tsx` were installed from the official shadcn registry on 2026-09-23 using `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add field` (new-york / Radix). They support the authentication gate only; the chat remains EVE's provided interface.

Local changes: use the existing `@/lib/utils` helper, repository formatting, strict equality, stable deduplicated error keys, and a documented composite-group accessibility lint suppression. License: MIT, included here.
